methodology.transport: HTTP/1.1 POST over 127.0.0.1, Node fetch with 4 client loader(s), isolated fresh server process per repeat; workers persist through warmup
methodology.payload: Pre-serialized JSON {sequence,payload}; ascii payload with 1024 raw UTF-8 bytes, named message events, IDs 1..events; multiline mode adds mixed JSON whitespace line endings
methodology.schedule: All candidates yield each batch; native/Hono/Fastify also await backpressure where their APIs expose it
methodology.order: Rotated candidate order by repeat; sequential measured trials
methodology.warmup: Each fresh server gets warmup full workload passes before its one measured pass
methodology.firstEvent: Request start until first chunk containing a complete validated event is processed; not per-event latency
methodology.memory: Server RSS before/after measured workload; processPeakRssBytes includes imports and warmup
methodology.cpu: Server CPU user+system delta covering measured workload and stats IPC; excludes startup and warmup
methodology.clientCpu: Parent process user+system CPU delta covering fetch, body parsing and independent validation; high utilization can cap throughput
methodology.scope: Server framing/HTTP delivery only. No package clients, Kit routing/build, browser UI, broadcast, replay, slow consumers or production network
